parameter_meaning.Q: angular acceleration spectral density rad^2/s^3, integrated over actual dt
parameter_meaning.R: effective observation residual variance rad^2; includes model and timing mismatch, not isolated detector noise
parameter_meaning.P0: position variance constrained to R; velocity variance fitted; initial velocity zero

validation_scope: next-observation variable-horizon error against YOLO/commanded-pose bearing, not true target angle; fixed 0.72s forecast is not directly validated

validation_result.decision: retain as provisional candidate; not selected for deployment; two-point CV has lower held-out RMSE
